title: Keema Paratha
description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with dry spiced mutton mince, a hearty Punjabi breakfast served with curd and pickle.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: 1 tbsp for the filling and the rest for cooking

steps: Knead the atta with about 130 ml of water and half the salt into a soft dough, cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil and fry the onion and green chilli for 3 minutes, then add the ginger garlic paste and cook for a minute.
Add the mutton mince, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and garam masala and cook on medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes until completely dry and cooked.
Add the remaining salt and coriander leaves and cool the filling completely.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, stuff each with a spoon of keema, seal and roll gently into a round.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little of the remaining oil on both sides until browned and the keema is hot.
